segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so just to make sure I heard it right, you’re looking at 48 users for the operations team, annual term, and you want training completed before the October 7 go-live.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That’s right. Forty-eight is the full count, but only 42 people need access on day one. The other six are supervisors starting later in Q4.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Totally fine. The order can start with 42 seats at $68 per user per month, billed annually. If you add the six later, they’ll be prorated and co-termed to the same June 30 end date.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And the implementation package you quoted was $4,800, correct? I need to know if that’s one invoice or separate.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct, $4,800 one-time. We can put software and implementation on the same invoice, net 30, unless your AP team needs services broken out as a separate line.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Same invoice is better. Our PO will be for the total first-year amount plus implementation, so I just need the tax estimate and the legal entity name.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep. Pre-tax total for 42 seats is $34,272 for the year, plus the $4,800 implementation fee, so $39,072 before tax. The order form will show our legal entity and remit-to details.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. On the timeline, if we sign by September 12, are we still okay for admin training the week of the 23rd?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. We’d do the kickoff on September 17, admin training September 24, and end-user training October 2. That leaves a few business days for your managers to review settings before launch.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Works for me. Send the order form with those dates and the 42-seat start. I’ll route it with the PO request this afternoon.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send it over today with the pricing, net 30 terms, and the implementation dates in the notes.
